headline: Pets, with teeth! - versions 1.4.1 - 1.4.6
openingRemarks: New Pets w/ battle effects, Foe ability changes & ongoing balance

newFeatures.title: Pets, with teeth!
newFeatures.description: Six new pets have arrived to help you battle the Dark Forces, and existing pets now have battle effects! They all have their unique effects in battle and can be bought with Photon Tokens from the inventory page 'pets' section.

newFeatures.title: Poltergeist, Phantom, & Phantasm ability changes
newFeatures.description: The Poltergeist now has 'Paranormal Pandemonium', which will randomly scramble your non-zero stats before battle. The Phantom now has the old Poltergeist ability: 'Shadowy Influx' (health bonus). The Phantasm now has 'Unholy Armor' (high defense - armor & health).

bugFixes: Fixed a bug that prevented the 'Leveled up' window from popping up. The Owl wasn't too happy with this.
Fixed a bug that made the 'QP Activated' message persist longer than it was meant to.
balanceChanges: Effectiveness of armor has been decreased by a moderate amount.
Power & health stats received a relative buff: the foes health & power now don't scale as effectively against your own. This will make power and/or health builds more viable.
Recovery - both the health gain per hour and chance to revive from KO early have been nerfed, as mentioned in a reddit thread last week.
Lastly, various smaller difficulty tweaks are being made to make the game balanced at low, medium, and high levels.
miscDetails: Improved the code behind the scenes for matching up against foes.

When trying to go to battle and you're below 80% health, the message now displays how much health is required before you can go to battle. This message also now accurately displays your actual recovery per hour.
SuperPoekie, your cat wandered into the game. Please come pick him up.
closingRemarks: A lot of the hard work from months ago is slowly paying off. Big technical challenges solved from this winter are allowing for cool new features like pets with battle effects. Each improvement you're seeing is built on a previous one. Let me know what you think or would like to see!
